merge

Implement merge_intervals(intervals) for closed intervals on the real number line with integer endpoints. Merge exactly when next_start <= current_end. Shared endpoints merge: [1,3] and [3,4] become [1,4]. Consecutive integer endpoints do NOT merge: [1,4] and [5,7] stay separate. Return sorted lists. Do not mutate input; handle empty input.
cache
Implement class LRUCache(capacity) with get(key) returning -1 for missing, and put(key,value). Evict least recently used on overflow. Handle capacity zero. Use O(1) operations.

c=LRUCache(2); c.put(1,1); c.put(2,2); assert c.get(1)==1; c.put(3,3); assert c.get(2)==-1; c.put(1,8); c.put(4,4); assert c.get(3)==-1; assert c.get(1)==8
z=LRUCache(0); z.put(1,2); assert z.get(1)==-1
toposort
Implement topological_sort(graph) where graph maps nodes to lists of outgoing neighbors. Include neighbor-only nodes. Return a valid order, raising ValueError on any cycle. Handle empty graph.
json_patch

Implement apply_patch(document, operations), supporting only top-level JSON object keys and operations add, replace, remove, test. Each op has op, path and optionally value. Paths begin / and encode ~ as ~0 and / as ~1. Reject invalid escapes or nested paths with ValueError. Empty-string key is valid as path /. add may overwrite; replace/remove/test require an existing key. Failed test or invalid operation raises ValueError. Return a deep copy, never mutate document, operations, or nested values. Python standard library only.
ttl_cache

Implement TTLCache(capacity, clock), with put(key,value,ttl), get(key,default=None), and len(cache). clock() gives monotonic seconds. TTL starts on put; expires when now >= expiry. get does not refresh TTL but makes live entries most recently used. put replaces and refreshes. On overflow evict least recently used live entry after removing expired entries. ttl<=0 removes the key. capacity=0 stores nothing. len excludes expired entries. Standard library only.

now=[0];c=TTLCache(2,lambda:now[0]);c.put('a',1,10);c.put('b',2,2)
now[0]=2;assert c.get('b','missing')=='missing';assert len(c)==1
c.put('c',3,20);assert c.get('a')==1;c.put('d',4,20);assert c.get('c') is None
now[0]=10;assert c.get('a') is None;assert len(c)==1
c.put('d',5,1);now[0]=11;assert c.get('d') is None
c.put('x',1,3);c.put('x',2,0);assert len(c)==0
z=TTLCache(0,lambda:0);z.put('a',1,20);assert len(z)==0
utf8_stream

Implement decode_chunks(chunks), accepting an iterable of bytes chunks and returning the combined UTF-8 string. Decode incrementally with strict error handling: raise UnicodeDecodeError on invalid sequences or incomplete final sequences. Empty chunks and arbitrary split boundaries must work. Do not concatenate all input bytes first; standard library only.
dependency_levels

Implement dependency_levels(graph). graph maps string task names to lists of prerequisite task names. Include prerequisite-only names. Return sorted lists of tasks by earliest runnable parallel batch: tasks in a batch depend only on earlier batches. Deduplicate repeated prerequisites. Raise ValueError for cycles including self cycles. Do not mutate input; empty graph returns [].
overlap_search

Implement find_all(text, pattern) returning starting indices of every substring occurrence, including overlaps. Empty pattern matches all len(text)+1 boundaries. Work on Python strings and Unicode. Use O(len(text)+len(pattern)) time; no regex or external packages.

import random
assert find_all('aaaa','aa')==[0,1,2];assert find_all('abc','')==[0,1,2,3]
assert find_all('ééé','éé')==[0,1]
r=random.Random(294)
for _ in range(200):
 s=''.join(r.choice('abé') for _ in range(r.randrange(30)));p=''.join(r.choice('abé') for _ in range(r.randrange(8)))
 expected=[i for i in range(len(s)+1) if s.startswith(p,i)];assert find_all(s,p)==expected
assert len(find_all('a'*100000,'a'*1000))==99001
